public.text: SGI maturity is described using a terminology-management maturity model adapted across all metadata components. A terminology-specific model may not fully address information models, registry schemas, mappings, implementation guides, and computable guidelines.
public.suggestedRevision: Develop or reference a broader semantic-governance maturity model and explain which terminology-model dimensions can be reused and which additional capabilities are needed for other asset types.
